_comment: Baselines for bench/scope-emission/measure.mjs --check (#2699, #3532). Exact scope counts over the fixed synthetic corpus guard function-body suppression and removal of blocks without bindings. Each module has four Block scopes: two const-chosen branches, the lexical for environment, and the catch environment. Lookup-policy and name-claims captures decorate scopes and are excluded from this scope census; bench/scope-capture pins their full content. TypeScript and JavaScript retain separate baselines. emit_ms_budget is unchanged and carries headroom for shared CI runners.
